counterfactual.evidence: Off-chip bandwidth is at 61% (7.75 of 12.8 B/cycle) and miss penalty is 217 cycles compared to 180 cycles idle.

geometry.reasoning: Since all valid one-knob and LLC coupled moves have been refused, we propose a coupled move for L2 (l2_sets=2048, l2_ways=16) to put it in a massively larger regime, testing the counterfactual bottleneck at DRAM by attempting to filter misses earlier and reduce off-chip traffic.
